text: Physicists agree: the coffee machine is the most important instrument in the lab.
Lab cat found asleep on the trigger console. Data quality unaffected.
New particle discovered. On closer inspection, a crumb on the detector.
Reminder: the World Wide Web was invented at CERN, in 1989. You're welcome.
Theorists predict 400 new particles this week. Experimentalists find none.
Survey: most collisions happen where the beams cross.
Lake Geneva still there, reports the night shift.
Visitors ask if the collider could make a black hole. The safety team says no, again.
Weather forecast for the tunnel: a 100% chance of collisions.
Physicist explains the Standard Model in one sentence. It is a very long sentence.
The Large Hadron Collider is, officially, still very large.
Magnets cooled to 1.9 kelvin, colder than outer space. The office is still too warm.
Night owls report the quietest control room between midnight and five in the morning.
Rumour has it: up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right... and then?
Lab names itself after a particle. Colleagues are not impressed.
Patience pays, says a physicist who has not touched the mouse for ten minutes.
Lab tries five particle skins in one afternoon: "Fashion is physics too."
Matter and antimatter are not quite the same, lab finds. The universe is relieved to exist.
Two teams find the same particle and call it J and ψ. Neither backs down.
A third lepton turns up. Physicists hope it is the last one.
Gluons found: the glue that holds quarks together. Not available in shops.
Higgs boson found! Champagne supplies at a historic low.
Two new baryons found. The lab is running out of Greek letters.
A decay seen three times in a billion. About as likely as a quiet shift.
Light bounces off light. Sunglasses makers unconcerned.
Entangled top quarks: measure one, and the other one knows.
Neutrinos change flavour on the way. Physicists ask them to make up their minds.
Five quarks in one particle. Rumours of six already spreading.
First neutrinos caught at a collider. Billions of others got away.
Baryons and antibaryons caught decaying differently. Antimatter declines to comment.
Top quarks pair up for a very short romance, experiments confirm.
The Higgs boson is seen talking to itself. Experts say this is normal.
Dark matter particle found. It was in the last place anyone looked.
Quantum gravity solved. Physicists unsure what to do on Mondays now.
Every particle has a heavier twin, lab says. The twins have not been seen yet.
Everything is made of strings, lab says. The knitting club claims credit.
Master students take over the server room. The servers move to the corridor.
Summer students arrive. Pizza deliveries to the lab up 400%.
Nobel laureate joins the lab and immediately asks where the coffee is.
Shift crew reports a quiet night: only 40 million collisions a second.
Astronaut repairs your detector in orbit and calls the view from work "fine".
Thousands of volunteers lend their computers. Screensavers now very scientific.
The lab's explainer video goes viral. Nobody understands it; everybody loves it.
Tunnel robot finishes a 27-kilometre lap and asks for a raise.
Magnet factory reports record orders from "a lab with a very big ring".
Planners propose a 91-kilometre tunnel. Local moles concerned.
Time traveller reveals next week's results. Peer reviewers outraged.
Aliens join the collaboration and ask for their names on every paper.
You meet yourself in the corridor. Both of you pretend not to notice.
A Boltzmann brain fluctuates into existence and asks for an office with a window.
The universe expands. House prices unaffected.
Dark matter piles up. Nobody can see it, but everybody agrees it is there.
Lab moves to a new multiverse. Somebody left the coffee on in the old one.
The Standard Model fits on one blackboard. The cleaner refuses to wipe it.
First experiment done! Results "consistent with expectations".
Anomalies keep appearing on the detector. Advice: click them quickly.
LHC switched on. Earth still here, as predicted.
Future Circular Collider opens. "Future" to be dropped from the name.
Lab director reaches level 25, still not allowed to touch the magnets.
Personnel Office hires 300 people before lunch. Coffee machine overwhelmed.
